# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework (SENATE: senate). Generated by gen_territory_senate.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# All effects BYZ/ROM scope.

# WP11-5 helper (BYZ/ROM scope). Applies 4-seat-per-Prefecture delegation cap when var:oe_tsn_del_on ?= 1.
# Reads var:oe_tsn_p_ryc / rnc / ryt / rnt, accumulates into var:oe_tsn_tmp_yc / nc / yt / nt.
oe_tsn_cap_prefecture = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_tot value = var:oe_tsn_p_ryc }
    change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_tot add = var:oe_tsn_p_rnc }
    change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_tot add = var:oe_tsn_p_ryt }
    change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_tot add = var:oe_tsn_p_rnt }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tsn_del_on ?= 1 var:oe_tsn_p_tot > 4 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ry value = var:oe_tsn_p_ryc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ry add = var:oe_tsn_p_ryt }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rn value = var:oe_tsn_p_rnc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rn add = var:oe_tsn_p_rnt }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ry8 value = var:oe_tsn_p_ry }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ry8 multiply = 8 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_t7 value = var:oe_tsn_p_tot } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_t7 multiply = 7 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_t5 value = var:oe_tsn_p_tot } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_t5 multiply = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_t3 value = var:oe_tsn_p_tot } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_t3 multiply = 3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_ry8 >= var:oe_tsn_p_t7 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cy value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_ry8 >= var:oe_tsn_p_t5 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cy value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_ry8 >= var:oe_tsn_p_t3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cy value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_ry8 >= var:oe_tsn_p_tot } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cy value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cy value = 0 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cn value = 4 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cn subtract = var:oe_tsn_p_cy }
        # Split capped YES seats (0..4) between chartered cities (c) and exarchates/despotates (t)
        if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_tsn_p_cy <= 0 var:oe_tsn_p_ryc <= 0 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyc value = 0 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_ryt <= 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyc value = var:oe_tsn_p_cy } }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_w value = var:oe_tsn_p_ryc }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_w multiply = var:oe_tsn_p_cy }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_w multiply = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r7 value = var:oe_tsn_p_ry } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r7 multiply = 7 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r5 value = var:oe_tsn_p_ry } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r5 multiply = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r3 value = var:oe_tsn_p_ry } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r3 multiply = 3 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_r7 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyc value = 4 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_r5 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyc value = 3 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_r3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyc value = 2 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_ry } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyc value = 1 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyc value = 0 } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyt value = var:oe_tsn_p_cy }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cyt subtract = var:oe_tsn_p_cyc }
        # Split capped NO seats (0..4) between chartered cities (c) and exarchates/despotates (t)
        if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_tsn_p_cn <= 0 var:oe_tsn_p_rnc <= 0 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnc value = 0 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_rnt <= 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnc value = var:oe_tsn_p_cn } }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_w value = var:oe_tsn_p_rnc }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_w multiply = var:oe_tsn_p_cn }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_w multiply = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r7 value = var:oe_tsn_p_rn } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r7 multiply = 7 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r5 value = var:oe_tsn_p_rn } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r5 multiply = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r3 value = var:oe_tsn_p_rn } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_r3 multiply = 3 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_r7 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnc value = 4 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_r5 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnc value = 3 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_r3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnc value = 2 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_p_w >= var:oe_tsn_p_rn } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnc value = 1 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnc value = 0 } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnt value = var:oe_tsn_p_cn }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_cnt subtract = var:oe_tsn_p_cnc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_yc add = var:oe_tsn_p_cyc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_nc add = var:oe_tsn_p_cnc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_yt add = var:oe_tsn_p_cyt }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_nt add = var:oe_tsn_p_cnt }
    }
    else = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_yc add = var:oe_tsn_p_ryc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_nc add = var:oe_tsn_p_rnc }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_yt add = var:oe_tsn_p_ryt }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_nt add = var:oe_tsn_p_rnt }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_ryc remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_rnc remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_ryt remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_rnt
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_tot remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_ry remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_rn remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_ry8
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_t7 remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_t5 remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_t3
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_cy remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_cn remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_cyc remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_cyt
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_cnc remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_cnt remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_w
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_r7 remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_r5 remove_variable = oe_tsn_p_r3
}

# Contract. Put issue N to the senate: count the seats, store the tally, fire oe_tsn.1 (AI Byzantium/Rome answers it itself).
# While another vote is pending the request is queued and put to the vote by the monthly pulse.
oe_tsn_request = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_req value = $issue$ }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_pending }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_queue_1 value = 1 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_queue_2 value = 1 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_queue_3 value = 1 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_queue_4 value = 1 } }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 1 } remove_variable = oe_tsn_queue_1 } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 2 } remove_variable = oe_tsn_queue_2 } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 3 } remove_variable = oe_tsn_queue_3 } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_req ?= 4 } remove_variable = oe_tsn_queue_4 }
        oe_tsn_count = { issue = $issue$ }
        oe_tsn_pv_check = yes  # round 7 F4 + v26.0 O(1) cache verification
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_pending value = 1 months = 6 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tsn } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tsn value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tsn add = 1 }  # third round T3: event count
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tsn.1
    }
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_req
}

# Contract. Called by the main session at every campaign start: issue 2, the war levy.
oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = { oe_tsn_request = { issue = 2 } }

# Counts the seats for the issue passed by oe_tsn_request (with WP11-5 4-Prefecture delegation cap when active).
# Per-seat votes: theme var oe_tsn_vote, IO vars oe_tsn_hvote_<n>.
oe_tsn_count = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    save_scope_as = oe_tsn_emp
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_issue value = $issue$ }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_c value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_c value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_t value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_t value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_h value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_h value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_cn value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_tn value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_yc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_nc value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_yt value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_tmp_nt value = 0 }
	    if = { limit = { oe_tsn_delegation_mode = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_del_on value = 1 } }
	    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_del_on value = 0 } }
	    every_subject = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_vote } remove_variable = oe_tsn_vote }
	    # provinces: record each seated theme's vote once, plus raw opposing-province counts for tooltips
	    every_subject = {
	        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes }
	        if = { limit = { oe_tsn_theme_score >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_vote value = 1 } }
	        else = {
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_vote value = -1 }
	            if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_cn add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_tn add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    # provinces: tally per Prefecture (P1-P4) and apply 4-seat delegation cap when active
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt value = 0 }
	    every_subject = {
	        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes }
	        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt add = 1 } } }
	        else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt add = 1 } } }
	    }
	    oe_tsn_cap_prefecture = yes
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt value = 0 }
	    every_subject = {
	        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_2 = yes }
	        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt add = 1 } } }
	        else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt add = 1 } } }
	    }
	    oe_tsn_cap_prefecture = yes
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt value = 0 }
	    every_subject = {
	        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_3 = yes }
	        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt add = 1 } } }
	        else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt add = 1 } } }
	    }
	    oe_tsn_cap_prefecture = yes
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt value = 0 }
	    every_subject = {
	        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes oe_theme_in_prefecture_4 = yes }
	        if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnc add = 2 } } }
	        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_vote ?= 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_ryt add = 1 } } }
	        else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_p_rnt add = 1 } } }
	    }
	    oe_tsn_cap_prefecture = yes
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_c value = var:oe_tsn_tmp_yc } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_c value = var:oe_tsn_tmp_nc }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_t value = var:oe_tsn_tmp_yt } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_t value = var:oe_tsn_tmp_nt }
	    remove_variable = oe_tsn_tmp_yc remove_variable = oe_tsn_tmp_nc remove_variable = oe_tsn_tmp_yt remove_variable = oe_tsn_tmp_nt remove_variable = oe_tsn_del_on
	    # houses on the roll
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	        remove_variable = oe_tsn_hvote_1
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_1 }
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_house_score_1 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_1 value = 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_h add = 1 } } }
	            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_1 value = -1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_h add = 1 } } }
	        }
	        remove_variable = oe_tsn_hvote_2
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_2 }
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_house_score_2 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_2 value = 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_h add = 1 } } }
	            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_2 value = -1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_h add = 1 } } }
	        }
	        remove_variable = oe_tsn_hvote_3
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_3 }
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_house_score_3 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_3 value = 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_h add = 1 } } }
	            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_3 value = -1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_h add = 1 } } }
	        }
	        remove_variable = oe_tsn_hvote_4
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_4 }
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_house_score_4 >= 50 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_4 value = 1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_h add = 1 } } }
	            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_hvote_4 value = -1 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_h add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    # court officials
	    if = { limit = { oe_court_chancellor_filled = yes }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 10 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 10 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 0 } }
	        var:oe_court_chancellor = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_official_score >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    if = { limit = { oe_court_judge_filled = yes }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 20 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 0 } }
	        var:oe_court_judge = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_official_score >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    if = { limit = { oe_court_secretary_filled = yes }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 10 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 0 } }
	        var:oe_court_secretary = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_official_score >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    if = { limit = { oe_court_taxmaster_filled = yes }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 15 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 10 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 0 } }
	        var:oe_court_taxmaster = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_official_score >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    if = { limit = { oe_court_ceremonies_filled = yes }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 10 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 0 } }
	        var:oe_court_ceremonies = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_official_score >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    if = { limit = { oe_court_admiral_filled = yes }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 15 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 10 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 0 } }
	        var:oe_court_admiral = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_official_score >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    if = { limit = { oe_court_domestikos_filled = yes }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 15 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 5 } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tsn_issue ?= 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 10 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_lean value = 0 } }
	        var:oe_court_domestikos = {
	            if = { limit = { oe_tsn_official_score >= 50 } scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes_o add = 1 } } }
	            else = { scope:oe_tsn_emp = { change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no_o add = 1 } } }
	        }
	    }
	    remove_variable = oe_tsn_lean
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes value = var:oe_tsn_yes_c }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no value = var:oe_tsn_no_c }
	    change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes add = var:oe_tsn_yes_t } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no add = var:oe_tsn_no_t }
	    change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes add = var:oe_tsn_yes_h } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no add = var:oe_tsn_no_h }
	    change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_yes add = var:oe_tsn_yes_o } change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_no add = var:oe_tsn_no_o }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_seats_cached value = var:oe_tsn_yes }
	    change_variable = { name = oe_tsn_seats_cached add = var:oe_tsn_no }
	}
}

# Force a failed bill through: -5 Imperial Authority, every province that voted against loyalty -10 (5 years),
# every house that voted against -25 influence. Flag oe_tsn_forced is set until oe_tsn_done.
oe_tsn_force = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
	    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_tsn_vote ?= -1 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -10 } }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_1 var:oe_tsn_hvote_1 ?= -1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = -25 } }
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_2 var:oe_tsn_hvote_2 ?= -1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = -25 } }
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_3 var:oe_tsn_hvote_3 ?= -1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = -25 } }
	        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_dynasty_4 var:oe_tsn_hvote_4 ?= -1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = -25 } }
	    }
	    set_variable = oe_tsn_forced
	}
}

# End of a vote (every option of oe_tsn.1).
# v6.5 M5 (gen_m5_merit.py, decision 200): oe_tsn_last_pass is held for 5 years after a vote that passed and was not
# forced; a vote that failed (accepted or forced through) clears it. The option with no bill changes nothing.
oe_tsn_done = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_pending oe_tsn_passed = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_tsn_forced } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_last_pass value = 1 years = 5 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_pending has_variable = oe_tsn_last_pass } remove_variable = oe_tsn_last_pass }
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_pending
    remove_variable = oe_tsn_forced
    oe_tsn_refresh_preview_cache = yes
}

# Issue 1, the extra levy.
oe_tsn_apply_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ts_levy_extra value = 0.05 years = 5 }
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ts_charter = yes var:oe_tsn_vote ?= -1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_objector value = 1 years = 5 } }
}
oe_tsn_reject_1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_rejected_1 value = 1 years = 10 } }
# Requested from the action and by the AI: -2 Imperial Authority, 10-year cooldown, vote.
oe_tsn_levy_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -2 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_levy_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
	    oe_tsn_request = { issue = 1 }
	}
}

# Issue 2, the war levy at a campaign start.
oe_tsn_apply_2 = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tsn_war_levy years = 5 mode = replace } }
oe_tsn_reject_2 = { set_variable = { name = oe_tsn_rejected_2 value = 1 years = 5 } }

# Monthly: the war levy ends with the campaign, queued votes, and O(1) preview cache refresh.
oe_tsn_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tsn_war_levy NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active } } remove_country_modifier = oe_tsn_war_levy }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_queue_2 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active } } remove_variable = oe_tsn_queue_2 }
    oe_tsn_refresh_preview_cache = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_tsn_idle = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_queue_2 } oe_tsn_request = { issue = 2 } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_queue_3 } oe_tsn_request = { issue = 3 } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_queue_4 } oe_tsn_request = { issue = 4 } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tsn_queue_1 } oe_tsn_request = { issue = 1 } }
    }
}

# Yearly, AI Byzantium/Rome: ask for the levy when gold < 100, Imperial Authority >= 20 and at least 2 seated provinces pay tribute.
oe_tsn_ai_yearly = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = yes gold < 100 oe_tsn_levy_allowed = yes trigger_if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 20 } } trigger_else = { always = no } any_subject = { count >= 2 oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes } }
        oe_tsn_levy_start = yes
    }
}

# ---- dev-mod test helper: a vote on issue 1 without cost or cooldown.
oe_tsn_test_levy_vote = { oe_tsn_request = { issue = 1 } }
